title: City Services Budget Workshop
summary:
*   City officials convened for a special budget workshop to review upcoming spending proposals.
*   Key departments presented their budget plans, including the Convention Center, Environmental & Conservation Services, Aviation, Parks and Recreation, and Libraries.
*   The meeting focused on informational presentations using slides and budget documents, with no policy decisions made during the session.
